video_caption: The video begins with a black screen displaying the title in white text: "J. MORGAN PUETT: A PRACTICE OF BE(E)ING". A small, stylized white bee graphic hovers below the text, while a geometric pattern of grey, three-dimensional hexagons, resembling a honeycomb, occupies the bottom right corner of the screen. This dissolves into a blurred, desaturated outdoor scene, viewed through what appears to be a wet window, with indistinct shapes of distant buildings and foliage, and faint reflections of light. The shot then tightens to a close-up of several dry seed pods on a slender dark stem, with delicate, feathery white filaments protruding from them against a soft, out-of-focus background.

The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown textured sweater, sitting on a red tufted couch in an indoor setting. She is speaking and gesturing with her hands, with bookshelves filled with books and an abstract painting visible in the background. The scene then transitions to an outdoor shot of a field of dried, light brown and greyish tall grasses or weeds, gently swaying. In the background, green and bare trees are visible, suggesting a cooler season, while the foreground plants are slightly blurred. This is followed by a shot of an old, weathered light-colored wooden house with a tin roof and a rickety porch, partially obscured by trees and dense foliage. Two people, seen from behind, are walking on a dirt path away from the camera towards the house; one person has short dark hair and a light-colored top, and the other has longer dark hair and a dark-colored top.

The video segment opens with a close-up shot of a large pile of bleached animal bones, including skulls and various other skeletal fragments, resting on a dark, possibly rusted metal surface amidst rocks and moss. This transitions to a medium shot of a woman with short, gray hair and round glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater, speaking with thoughtful expressions and hand gestures while seated on a red sofa in front of a bookshelf filled with books. The scene then changes to an external view of a white, modernist building with angular and circular architectural elements set against a blue sky with scattered clouds. Following this, the interior of a room is shown, featuring light-colored walls with several framed black-and-white photographs leaning against them, and a long table meticulously set with multiple vintage teacup sets, candelabras, and glassware, creating a formal dining atmosphere. The segment concludes with an outdoor shot of a rustic, open-air vanity area constructed from wooden planks, featuring an antique white sink, a mirror, and a small table with a vase of flowers, all set on a wooden deck surrounded by green grass and trees.

The video opens with a woman with short, gray hair and glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater, sitting on a red velvet couch and gesturing with her hands as she speaks. A dark wooden bookshelf filled with books is visible behind her. The scene then cuts to a black background with white text, defining the word "hoosh (bōoSH), v." as "1. a practice of conceptually charged arranging, cleaning. 2. the stylistic activation and conceptual engagement with one's environment," under the title "MILDRED'S LANE Glossary of Terms," with a subtle image of a bee below. Subsequently, the setting changes to a rustic, densely packed kitchen with the same woman, now wearing a black apron over her brown sweater, walking around, arranging items, and speaking while gesturing with her hands. The kitchen features numerous hanging pots, pans, and shelves filled with jars and dishes. Another woman with short, light gray hair is then shown from the chest up, smiling and listening intently with her hand under her chin, before the scene returns to the first woman in the kitchen, continuing to speak and gesticulate.

The video opens with a person in a dark brown sweater arranging items in a rustic kitchen, followed by a woman with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater, speaking and gesturing while seated on a red velvet couch in a room with bookshelves. Subsequent scenes show two people, one in a dark brown sweater and another with light hair in a brown top, working together to prepare a table and chairs with white linens, moving furniture, and covering chairs with slipcovers, suggesting a collaborative setup. The woman on the couch reappears, continuing her discussion. The video then transitions to a black screen with white text: "J. Morgan Puett," "Born: 1957, Hahira, Georgia.," "Children: Grey Rabbit Puett," and "Collaborators: Mark Dion, Robert Williams, Jorge Colombo, Allison Smith, Hope Ginsburg, Jeffrey Jenkins, Rebecca Purcell, Amy Yoes, Paul Bartow, et al." The text is superimposed over a blurred dictionary page background with two bee illustrations on the right.

The video segment opens with a middle-aged woman with short, gray hair and round glasses sitting comfortably on a tufted red velvet couch, wearing a loose, brown knitted sweater. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands as bookshelves filled with books and a framed artwork are visible behind her, suggesting a cozy, intellectual setting. Her expression is engaged and thoughtful as she talks. At the 0:03 mark, the scene transitions to the same woman, now wearing a lighter-colored top and a brown apron, standing in what appears to be a workshop or studio. She is actively involved in a task, holding a long strand of dark beads in one hand and a tool, possibly a spoon or stirrer, in the other, dipping the beads into a rectangular basin containing an unknown substance. The background of this scene shows more tools and materials, indicating a creative or crafting environment.

In a workshop setting, a woman with short, dark hair and glasses, wearing a light long-sleeved shirt and a brown apron, stands focused on her task. She is carefully lifting a long, intricate string adorned with numerous small, dark, teardrop-shaped ornaments from a rectangular, dark container. As she raises the string, excess dark liquid drips from the ornaments back into the container, suggesting a dyeing or coating process. Her left hand seems to be steadying the string or using a tool to assist, while her right hand holds the bulk of the decorative piece. A bright desk lamp illuminates the workspace from above, and various tools, cloths, and other objects are visible in the blurred background, reinforcing the impression of an artist's or craftsperson's studio.

The video opens with a close-up of a person's hands holding a long, decorative string of dark, teardrop-shaped beads or tassels, carefully arranging them. The scene then transitions to a woman with short, gray hair and round glasses, wearing a chunky brown knit sweater, sitting comfortably on a tufted red velvet couch. She is speaking and gesturing with her hands, with a large bookshelf filled with books and a dark abstract painting behind her. She smiles while talking about getting involved with the international fashion world. The camera cuts back to the same woman, now in a light-colored tunic-like shirt and a brown apron, reaching up to hang the beaded string on a metal rod that has various hangers and pieces of fabric draped over it. The setting appears to be a well-lit studio or workshop with large windows and an industrial feel. She then resumes speaking on the red couch. The video fades to black before displaying white text on a dark background: "In 1997, Puett, Mark Dion and friends, purchased a 95 acre plot of land in the middle of the deciduous forest of Pennsylvania. They named the property Mildred's Lane." An illustration of a beehive and a bee are also visible on the screen. The scene returns to the woman on the red couch, continuing her narrative about looking for a place. She then appears seated on the floor in her workshop attire, meticulously working with pieces of dark fabric or leather spread out around her. She picks up a piece, folds it, and seems to be engaged in a crafting or sewing activity. The background shows wooden tables and large windows, suggesting a spacious work area. The video ends with the woman back on the red couch, still speaking and gesturing with her hands.

A woman with short, grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater, sits on a red velvet couch, speaking and gesturing with her hands. Behind her are dark bookshelves filled with books and a painting. The scene transitions to an overhead view of the woman, now in a light-colored long-sleeved shirt and overalls, kneeling on a white sheet on the floor, tracing patterns onto dark fabric pieces; cardboard cutouts frame the scene. The woman returns to the couch, continuing to speak, then is shown in a close-up, meticulously arranging fabric pieces on the white sheet. She reappears on the couch, concluding her thought with a thumbs-up. The video then displays text overlays on a black and white dictionary page background, stating: "Initially living in a refurbished horse shed, Puett, Dion and artist friends have collaborated on adding small outbuildings and livable installations to the site. The main house, designed by Puett, was erected in 2000. Mildred's Lane continues to evolve as projects, installations and dwellings are built." This is followed by an animated graphic comparing hexagonal shapes (labeled "fully utilized space") with circular shapes arranged in a pyramid (labeled "wasted spatial gap"). More text appears on the dictionary background: "Mildred's Lane currently has rustic accommodations for 25 people and often hosts dinners and lectures for up to 100 people. One of the installations is The Grafter's Shack." A close-up shows an old oil lamp, a book titled "THE GRAFTER'S SHACK," and another titled "The Life of the Bee" on a wooden surface. The video then enters a rustic interior, likely "The Grafter's Shack," adorned with hanging beekeeping nets and hoods, a bed with striped pillows, and walls covered in text-filled pages and small framed pictures. Finally, the woman, wearing a light-colored dress with dark straps and holding greenery, stands contemplatively outside the rustic wooden building with a screened window, surrounded by lush green foliage. Throughout the text and interior scenes, a melodic humming or singing track plays.

The video opens with a woman in beige overalls standing beside a rustic wooden shack with a screened window, looking off to the right. She transitions to sitting on a red velvet couch in a room with bookshelves filled with books behind her. She wears a brown, textured sweater and round glasses, speaking and gesturing with her hands. The scene then shows close-ups of beekeeping equipment: a mesh bee suit, a wide-brimmed hat, and a metal funnel hanging from a wooden beam, followed by several metal bee smokers arranged on a shelf. The woman on the couch reappears, continuing to speak, before the camera pans across a wooden desk inside the shack, displaying a striped cloth-wrapped package, pieces of honeycomb, a candlestick, a framed collection of small, round, organic items, and various papers taped to the wooden walls. A white lab coat or shirt, covered in printed text, hangs on a hanger against a wall also adorned with pages of text. The woman on the couch returns, gesturing with flat hands, emphasizing her points. This transitions to a black screen with white text in the center: "MILDRED'S LANE," "Glossary of Terms," and then "work-styles (werk-stils), n. (often attributive) the embodiment of any practitioners' work-live-research environment as a developed and rigorous engagement with every aspect of life." (work-styles (werk-stils), noun (often attributive) the embodiment of any practitioners' work-live-research environment as a developed and rigorous engagement with every aspect of life.) A dictionary page serves as a subtle background texture for the text, with an illustration of a worm gear on the right. The video concludes with a wide shot of a snowy, unpaved road winding through a forest, with a snow-dusted mailbox in the foreground.

The video begins with a static shot of a mailbox on a snowy roadside; the mailbox is black with snow partially covering it, and a white sign with an arrow reads "MILDRED'S LANE," while other text like "SIT PLANK road" and "Dion" is visible. The scene then shifts indoors to a woman with short, grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater and dark leggings, sitting on a red tufted couch and gesturing with her hands as she speaks, with a large bookshelf and artwork in the background. Following this, an outdoor scene shows a group of approximately 15-20 casually dressed people gathered on a wooden deck next to a rustic, red-brown building with an open barn-style door, some standing and conversing, others seated on benches. The perspective then changes to an aerial view of about ten people sitting in a circle on a large, flat rock formation at the edge of a dark body of water, surrounded by trees. Finally, the video shows a woman in an orange sweater addressing a seated audience of over twenty people within a rustic, barn-like structure, characterized by wooden beams, a blackboard, and natural light streaming through a large window.

The video features a montage of diverse activities and settings. It begins with a woman in an orange top speaking to a seated audience in a rustic, wooden-beamed hall, followed by a close-up of several individuals intently engaged in craftwork around a table, manipulating small objects and tools, including a small, fleshy, bird-like figure. The scene then shifts outdoors to an alleyway where a man in a waistcoat performs a puppet show, gesturing with papers in front of a booth adorned with red and yellow balls, flanked by wooden and stone buildings. An interview-style shot shows a woman with glasses and a brown sweater sitting on a red velvet couch against a backdrop of bookshelves, speaking expressively with hand gestures. This is followed by a group of people standing in a bright, modern room, listening to a man, with a striking life-sized skeletal figure dressed in a trench coat on display. The video transitions back to the rustic hall, where a man presents an image projected onto a large screen to an attentive audience, concluding with the woman on the red couch continuing her discussion with thoughtful gestures.

The video segment opens with a daytime outdoor scene showing a group of people casually seated on a wooden deck next to a rustic sink and a wooden building, conversing. This transitions to a woman with short gray hair and glasses speaking to a small group under green foliage. A wider shot reveals an outdoor dinner party in a grassy field in front of a large, weathered wooden barn-like building, with a band performing on a small stage. The scene changes to a white, multi-tiered sculptural structure standing in a grassy field surrounded by trees. People are then shown seated at dinner tables in the field, looking towards the white structure. Inside, the woman with short gray hair and glasses, wearing a brown sweater, sits on a red velvet couch, gesturing expressively while speaking about conversation and good food, with bookshelves visible behind her. The setting shifts to night, with people gathered around what appears to be a bonfire, some dancing or mingling. Close-ups show faces illuminated by firelight. The white structure from earlier is now engulfed in a massive bonfire, flames reaching high into the dark sky, with people watching from a distance. The intense fire consumes the intricate details of the structure. The scene returns to the woman on the couch, continuing to speak as small, bright embers float across the screen. These embers then fill a black screen, slowly revealing text: "MILDRED'S LANE Glossary of Terms" at the top, followed by "com·port·ment (kəmˈpôrtmənt), n. 1. personal bearing or conduct. 2. demeanor. 3. behavior (in this context, our behavior in the 21st century)." The background of the text is a faded dictionary page with a hand-drawn illustration. The video then moves indoors to two women setting a long dining table with a white tablecloth. The woman in the brown sweater and glasses carefully places individual stacked teacups and saucers, which are visibly mismatched, onto each place setting. A close-up shows shelves filled with many different stacked teacups. The second woman, with short white hair, picks a teacup from a shelf and helps arrange the table, which features elaborate light blue painted wooden legs, multiple place settings with stacked teacups, glasses, a central candle, and two side tables with bowls and fruit.

The video opens with a shot of a rustic dining table set with white dishes and a lit candle, surrounded by shelves of kitchenware. It then transitions to a woman with short, grey hair and glasses, wearing a light-colored top and a brown apron, typing on a silver laptop at a desk. She pauses to write in a small notebook with a pen. The scene changes, and she is now sitting on a red tufted couch, gesturing with her hands while speaking, with bookshelves and artwork in the background. Next, she is seen outdoors, wearing a dark coat and a light scarf, looking out at a forested landscape. A close-up shows her hands holding a wicker basket with a covered dish and a white mug nearby. The video concludes with the woman back on the red couch, continuing to speak and gesture, uttering the phrase "ambassador of entanglement."

A woman with short, grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown knitted sweater, is seen talking and gesturing while seated on a red tufted couch in a room with a bookshelf filled with books and a painting behind her. She then appears outdoors, dressed in a dark coat and light scarf, holding an apple and interacting with a jar of what appears to be nuts or seeds, with outdoor string lights and foliage in the background. The scene transitions back to the woman on the couch, speaking earnestly. The video then cuts to a black screen displaying a white quote: "Mildred's Lane is a school about living, and it's not just a linear thing, it's a swarming. You can't put your finger on it... it's complex. It's a complexity." - J. Morgan Puett. This is followed by white rolling credits on a textured dark background, accompanied by traditional string music, with a small animated insect (moth/firefly) flying across the screen. The credits list various production roles, including cinematographers, art directors, stylist, editor, audio technician, camera assistant, production coordinator, animator, and music information. Finally, a white speech bubble with the text "ABOUT THEMSELVES" appears on a black screen before the video ends.
